2. How does PoR account for real-time backing during extreme volatility, and what cryptographic proof can users check that their token tier is 100% backed right now?

Binance maintains Proof of Reserves so users can verify that customer assets are backed, and users can check this through our official Proof of Reserves page and the self-verification tools provided there.

Our Proof of Reserves uses cryptographic methods, including Merkle Tree-based verification, to allow users to confirm their account balances were included in the snapshot. Reserve ratios and supported asset data are updated periodically on the official page, where users can review the latest available information.

Because Proof of Reserves is based on published snapshots rather than a live real-time feed, it should be understood as a transparency tool that helps users verify asset backing at the time of reporting. During periods of market volatility, Binance continues to manage reserves and user liabilities accordingly, while published PoR data reflects the most recent reporting cycle rather than an instant real-time state.

Independent assurance and review details, including methodology and reporting cadence where applicable, are also communicated through Binance’s official channels and Proof of Reserves materials. For the latest snapshot, supported assets, and verification steps, users should refer to Binance’s official Proof of Reserves resources.

1. Are my funds/user assets safe? Did users lose money?

User assets remain secure, and Binance has completed coverage of hacked assets in the security incident. Binance absorbed the impact so users did not bear the loss.

We also took immediate action to contain the incident, strengthen controls, and continue working with partners and investigators. If there are any further material updates, we will share them through our official channels.
